intended_use: Clinical decision support and prioritization of patients for ART care-engagement review.
clinical_role: Decision support only. The model does not make autonomous clinical decisions.

outcome.name: probable_art_care_interruption
outcome.definition: Absence from the August 2026 active ART line list combined with at least 180 days since the last documented ART visit, excluding patients documented as transferred out or deceased.

threshold_status: Prototype operational thresholds; not clinically validated.

data_quality_rules.key_population_type_160666: Recoded as Unknown/missing because it was treated as erroneous numeric-like identifier contamination.

limitations: Outcome represents probable ART care interruption rather than confirmed loss to follow-up.
No temporal or prospective validation has yet been completed.
Risk thresholds are operational prototype thresholds and are not clinically validated.
Predicted probabilities should not be interpreted as fully calibrated individual absolute risks.
Model predictions require clinician review and appropriate clinical context.
deployment_requirements: Use the frozen model artifact without modifying preprocessing.
Provide exactly the required feature names.
Validate incoming patient data before prediction.
Log model version used for each prediction.
Do not expose direct patient identifiers unnecessarily.
Monitor model performance and data drift.
Perform temporal/prospective validation before routine clinical deployment.
